source_text: Sed redeamus ad Apostolum Paulum, qui haec libero oculo mentis adspiciens velamen veteris testamenti abiciens ait prior populus exemplari et umbrae caelestium deservierit. Quattuor ordines castrorum exemplum sint quattuor ordinum quos ad Hebraeos Paulus in caelis numeravit; adice quaternos Levitarum. Caath sancta sanctorum in humeris portant; Gerson tabernaculi atria et pelles; Merari columnas et bases — virtute opus est. Aceipe numerum filiorum Caath: ordo alius introducitur ministeriorum.
pass_a_gloss: But let-us-return to Apostle Paul, who these with-free eye of-mind looking veil of-old testament casting-off says prior people to-pattern and shadow of-heavenly things served. Four orders of-camps example may-be of-four orders which to Hebrews Paul in heavens numbered; add fourfold of-Levites. Kohath holy of-holies on shoulders carry; Gershon of-tabernacle courts and skins; Merari columns and bases — with-strength need is. Take number of-sons of-Kohath: order another is-introduced of-ministries.
pass_b_english: But let us return to the Apostle Paul, who sees these things with an unveiled mind’s eye and, casting off the old covenant’s veil, says that the former people [[served a copy and shadow of the heavenly things >> Bible:Hebrews 8:5]]. Let the four camp-orders be an example of those four orders Paul numbers in the heavens when he writes to the Hebrews; add the Levites’ fourfold ministries. Kohath carries the holy of holies on the shoulders; Gershon the courts and skins of the tent; Merari the pillars and bases — strength is required. [[Take the number of the sons of Kohath >> Bible:Numbers 4:2]]: another order of ministry is introduced.
